Common questions

Before you register: the questions plumbers and builders ask us

Plumbers, builders, facility managers, electricians, architects and designers with an ABN. You can register first and send the ABN after.

5% off RRP ex GST on a single unit, 10% on 2 to 4, 20% on 5 to 9 and 25% on 10 or more. When a finish is on special, your price starts from the special, and a trade price is never higher than the current webstore price.

A one-page price list dated for the current prices. Every product and finish with its order code, minimum order, RRP, current price and your price at each of the 4 tiers. The order codes are the ones to quote when you order.

Polished Chrome ships as a single unit across the range, and the SD2000 soap dispenser is a single unit in every finish. Matt Black, Brushed Nickel, Brushed Brass, Champagne and Gunmetal carry a minimum order of 6. Below 6 is available only while that finish is in stock.

In stock ships straight away with priority despatch. Out of stock, Matt Black is 1 to 2 weeks and the other specialty finishes are 5 to 7 weeks.

Yes. Reece, Tradelink, Samios and other merchants can order Onvanti in for you, usually in 2 to 3 business days for standard finishes. Trade pricing applies when you order direct.

Both. Every Onvanti sensor tap runs on mains with the plug-in adapter included, or on 4 AA batteries, and the batteries take over automatically if the power drops. A licensed plumber does the water connection, and an electrician is only needed if a new outlet has to be installed.

Every sensor tap is WaterMark certified, 6 Star WELS rated and made from lead-free brass, and the range is access and mobility friendly under AS1428.1.

Sensor taps carry a 5-year parts warranty plus 12 months labour. The SD2000 soap dispenser carries 2 years. Spare parts are kept in stock in Australia.
